response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 26(3), directly establishes the requirement that when the country of origin of a food is given and it differs from that of its primary ingredient, the origin of the primary ingredient must also be given or it must be indicated that it is different. The verdict turns on this exact requirement, stating that both origins are declared in the specification. Therefore, the clause supports the verdict.
